title: US judges issue removal orders against 801 Indians in June
description: US immigration judges issued 801 removal orders for Indian nationals in June 2026. Nationwide deportation rulings accelerated significantly, with a nearly 30% increase in one month. The data shows immigration courts are disposing of cases at a much faster pace.

title: We are in India, be realistic, says HC, lifts curbs on hotel over 2 insects
description: The Bombay high court quashed a hotel's license suspension after finding minor hygiene issues. The Food and Drug Administration's drive aims to improve food safety across Maharashtra.  The court appreciated the state and FDA actions in enforcing food safety laws.
